title: Extend Rust page builder with headings, lists, and HTML escaping
description: The rust_page_builder library has a Page struct with add_paragraph and render. Add add_heading, add_list, and an escape_html helper. Tests live in the solution.

task_spec.prompt:
Extend src/lib.rs by adding three items to the Page struct and one standalone helper: 1. pub fn add_heading(&mut self, level: u8, text: &str) -> &mut Self — appends

...

based on level (clamp to 1–6); e.g. level=2 ->

text

2. pub fn add_list(&mut self, items: &[&str]) -> &mut Self — appends
    with one
  • per item; empty slice -> empty
      3. pub fn escape_html(text: &str) -> String (free function, not method) — replaces & -> & < -> < > -> > " -> " ' -> ' The three original tests must still pass. Add at least one test per new item (3+ new tests). All tests must pass: cargo test
followup_prompts: Good. Now add input validation and error handling to the feature you just implemented. What should happen with invalid, missing, or malformed inputs? Update the implementation and tests to cover those cases.
Run `cargo test` to verify everything including your new error handling. Fix any failures and confirm the feature is complete.
